title: CrafterDojo: An Integrated Research Suite for Building Open-Ended Embodied Agents in Crafter
abstract: arXiv:2508.13530v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Foundation models are central to building general-purpose embodied agents. Minecraft has become the dominant testbed for this paradigm, but its computational and engineering overhead limits rapid iteration and controlled analysis. Crafter offers a lightweight alternative yet lacks the foundation model ecosystem required for such research. We introduce CrafterDojo, a suite of foundation models, datasets, and data-generation toolkits that establishes Crafter as a testbed for foundation-model-based embodied intelligence, providing CrafterVPT, CrafterCLIP, and CrafterSteve-1. To address Crafter's data scarcity, CrafterDojo includes automatic tools that generate diverse synthetic demonstrations and aligned video-language pairs, yielding the CrafterPlay and CrafterCaption datasets. translated_title: CrafterDojo：用于在Crafter中构建开放式具身智能体的集成研究套件
translated_abstract: 基础模型是构建通用具身智能体的核心。Minecraft已成为这一范式的主导测试平台，但其计算和工程开销限制了快速迭代与可控分析。Crafter提供了一种轻量级替代方案，却缺乏此类研究所需的基础模型生态系统。我们提出CrafterDojo，这是一套包含基础模型、数据集和数据生成工具包的集成研究套件，将Crafter确立为基于基础模型的具身智能研究测试平台，提供了CrafterVPT、CrafterCLIP和CrafterSteve-1。为解决Crafter的数据稀缺问题，CrafterDojo包含可自动生成多样化合成演示数据和对齐视频-语言对的工具，由此构建了CrafterPlay和CrafterCaption数据集。实验表明，这些数据集能够支持有效的基础模型训练，并使分层智能体在任务表现上超越非分层基线。
tldr: CrafterDojo通过提供基础模型（CrafterVPT、CrafterCLIP、CrafterSteve-1）、合成数据集（CrafterPlay、CrafterCaption）及自动数据生成工具包，为轻量级环境Crafter构建了完整的基础模型生态，使其成为Minecraft之外研究开放式具身智能的高效测试平台。
en_tdlr: CrafterDojo establishes Crafter as a lightweight testbed for foundation-model-based open-ended embodied agents by providing foundation models (CrafterVPT, CrafterCLIP, CrafterSteve-1), synthetic datasets (CrafterPlay, CrafterCaption), and automatic data-generation toolkits.
